tei:div.tei:p: (ta)༄༅// gnod sbyin pho dgu mo dgu'i rig gtad gter bum sgrub thabs dang bcas pa 'dod rgu'i bum bzang zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ༄༅// oṃ swa sti/ nor bu'i rigs kyi sngags gtso bo// chos ldan kun gyi nor sgrub pa// 'phags pa dzaṃ bha lar btud nas// dpa' bo grub pa'i man ngag bshad// 'di nyid kyi rten nam 'khor lo mdun du bzhag la/ mchod gtor bzang pos mtha' bskor/ yi dam gyi bdag bskyed sngon du 'gro bas mchod pa rnams byin gyis brlab/ mdun bskyed bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ yig las byung ba'i srung 'khor gyi dbus su/ pam̐ las gser gyi pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa/ de'i lte ba dang 'dab ma rnams la dzam̐ dgu dang bam̐ dgu yongs su gyur pa las/ dbus su 'phags pa dzaṃ bha la nor rgyun mas yang dag par 'khyud pa/ shar du nor bu bzang po dang zla shel ma/ lho ru gang ba bzang po dang sbyin ma/ nub tu nor sbyin dang sbyin bzang ma/ byang du rnam thos kyi bu dang 'phags ma/ shar lhor ka li mā li dang*/ rab bzang ma/ lho nub tu 'jam po 'khyil pa dang rab sbas ma/ nub byang du zhal gyi dbang po dang lha'i bud med/ byang shar du spyod pa'i dbang po dang dbyangs can ma/ thams cad kyang sku mdog gser btso ma ltar rab tu 'bar ba/ dar dang rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ yab rnams rol pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs shing*/ phyag g.yas mchog sbyin gyi mthil na bī dza pū ra dang*/ g.yon pas gter gyi ne'u le 'dzin pa/ yum rnams g.yas mchog sbyin dang g.yon 'bras kyi snye ma bsnams pa'o// gnas gsum byin rlabs/ ye shes spyan 'dren/ dbang bskur rgyas gdab rnams spyi dang mthun/ ar+ghaṃ nas shab+da'i bar gyis mchod/ 'gro la dmigs med thugs rje yis// thabs mkhas rang bzhin sku sprul pa// gnod sbyin pho mo'i tshogs rnams la// mchod cing bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal// spro na/

dzam̐ bha la'i mtshan brgya dang*/ bstod pa rgyas pa dang*/ nor rgyun ma'i bstod pa rnams kyis kyang bstod do// oṃ dzaṃ bha la dza len+d+rā ya swā hā/ zhes ci nus su bzlas shing*/ oṃ ma ṇi bha drā ya swā hā/ oṃ pūr+ṇa bha drā ya swā hā/ oṃ dha na dā ya swā hā/ oṃ bai shra wa ṇā ya swā hā/ oṃ ke li mā li ni ye swā hā/ oṃ pi tsi kuṇ+ḍa le ni swā hā/ oṃ mu khen+d+rā ya swā hā/ oṃ tsa ren+d+rā ya swā hā/ oṃ ba su dha ri ṇ+yai swā hā/ oṃ tsan+d+rā kan+t+yai swā hā/ oṃ dat+tā yai swā hā/ oṃ su dat+tā yai swā hā/ oṃ ār+yā yai swā hā/ oṃ su bha drā yai swā hā/ oṃ su gup+tā yai swā hā/ oṃ de byai swā hā/ oṃ swa ra swa s+t+yai swā hā/ zhes pa rnams kyang ci rigs su bzlas la/ mthar chu sbyin spyi dang mthun par phul/ gtor ma bsang sbyang*/ 'bru gsum gyis byin gyis brlab/ nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags rgyas spel ba/ gtso 'khor so so'i sngags kyi mthar/ a kā ro btags pas 'bul te/ gtso bo la lan bdun dang*/ gzhan rnams la gsum gsum mo// mchod bstod/ 'dod don gsol gdab sogs spyi dang 'dra bar bya/ 'di'i rjes su gnang ba sbyin par 'dod na/ mdun bskyed kyi rten pho rkyang mo rkyang pho mo sbrags pa ste gsum mam/ 'khor lo gsum 'god/ ma 'grub na/ maṇ+ḍal gsum la de'i rim pas tshom bu bkod/ mtha' mchod gtor gyis bskor/ dbus su gong bzhin bskyed/ g.yas su gnod sbyin pho dgu'i dkyil 'khor bskyed/ g.yon du mo dgu'i bskyed/ gnas gsum byin rlabs man chad chabs cig tu bya/ slob ma rnams kyis gsol gdab yan lag bdun pa sgrub thabs brgya rtsa dang 'dra bar byas/ yi dam gyi nga rgyal 'dzin du bcug mdun bskyed rnams blo yul du nges par bskyed nas/ chu sbyin gtor 'bul mchod bstod rnams bya/ de nas sngags kyi bzlas lung sbyin te/ de nyid kyis slob ma'i bya ba 'grub pa yin no// 'khor lo kun la grags mod kyang*// rab dga'i bka' gtad shin tu dkon// snying nas tshul 'dir 'jug 'dod na// dang por rig gtad zhu ba gces// dzam̐ bha la lha mang gi sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no//

//'di'i sgom bzlas kyi lung 'bogs pa la slob dpon gyi bya ba dang*/ slob ma'i bya ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ gzhan la lung 'bogs pa'i sngon du rang nyid kyis nyams len tshar gcig bya dgos te/ maṇ+ḍa lar 'khor lo'am/ 'bru'i tshom bu lha grangs dang mnyam pa dgod/ de'i mdun gtsang sbra can gyi gtor zlum/ chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod g.yas skor du bsham/ rang nyid stan bde ba la 'dug ste skyabs 'gro sems bskyed tshad med bzhi bsgom pa sngon du 'gro bas/ swa bhā was sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las pad+ma dang nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ yongs su gyur pa las 'byung po 'dul byed sku mdog sngon po zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa g.yas dang pos rdo rje ba dan can gdengs pa/ g.yon dang pos thod pa lcang lo can 'dzin pa/ 'og ma gnyis rgyab tu mda' gzhu 'gengs pa/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ rlon pa'i do shal stag lpags kyi sham thabs can sbrul brgyad kyis dkris pa/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ de'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐ hūm̐ las 'od 'phros ye shes pa spyan drangs/ ar+ghaṃ la sogs pas mchod/ dza hūm̐ baṃ hoḥganyis su med par bstim/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas rigs lngas/ sangs rgyas rnams ni thams cad kyi// gsang gsum gnas las byung ba yi// khams gsum kun gyis phyag byas pa// rdo rje'i dbang bskur chen po sbyin// zhes bum pa'i chus dbang bskur/ dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan/ thugs kar nyi ma la gnas pa'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros/ 'byung po thams cad bran du bkol bar bsams te/ oṃ sum+bha ni sum+bha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ gṛh+ṇa pā ya gṛh+ṇa pā ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ā na ya hoḥ bha ga wān bid+ya rā dza hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces ci mang du bzla/

mchod pa rnams/ badz+ra a mṛ tas bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las/ rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du a las byung ba'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri mchog zhal zas/ rol mo la sogs pa mchod pa'i yo byad dwangs shing thogs pa med pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa rnams su gyur/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra pā d+yaṃ swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐ nas/ shab+da'i bar dang*/ oṃ sarba bid pū ra pū ra/ su ra su ra/ ā bar+t+ta ya ā bar+t+ta ya hūm̐/ rnams phyag rgya dang bcas pas byin brlab/ mdun bskyed bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ yig las byung ba'i srung 'khor gyi dbus su zhes pa nas/ mchod bstod 'dod don gsol gdab sogs spyi ltar bya ba'i bar gong lha mang sgrub thabs bzhin grub pa na/ gnyis pa ni/ slob ma rnams khrus byas gral du 'khod pa la sems bskyed gsal btab nas/ de la 'dir 'jam dpal dpa' bo gcig grub sogs las legs par gsungs shing rje btsun sa skya pa sogs tshad mar gyur pa'i skyes chen rnams kyis phyag bzhes brgyud mar gnang ba mgon po dzam+bha la lha mang gi sgom lung 'bogs par byed pa la/ thog mar sgom lung zab mo gsan pa'i slad du maṇ+ḍal 'bul bar zhu/ thal mo me tog dang bcas te 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ slob dpon gyis bdag la rig sngags dam pa stsal du gsol/ lan gsum/ de nas skyabs 'gro sems bskyed 'di dag dpon slob lhan cig pas gnang bar zhu/ zhes skyabs sems tshad med bzhi lan gsum/ de nas spyan dmigs 'di bzhin tu mdzad par 'tshal/ oṃ swa bhā wa sogs/ stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ las byung ba'i srung 'khor gyi dbus su khyed rang rnams gang du gnas pa'i go sar pad+ma dang nyi ma'i steng du sogs gong ltar la/ rang nyid ces pa dor/ khyed rang 'byung po 'dul byed ces bsgyur/ thugs kar hūm̐ gis mtshan par mos pa mdzod/

slob dpon kyang 'byung po 'dul byed du gsal ba'i thugs kar zla ba la gnas pa'i sngags phreng*/ de las sngags phreng gnyis pa chad/ zhal nas 'thon/ khyed rang rnams kyi zhal du zhugs/ thugs kar zla ba la 'khod pa'i mos pas sngags 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ oṃ sum+bha sogs lan gsum/ rig pa 'dzin pa 'di rnams kyi rgyud la bcom ldan 'das 'byung po 'dul byed kyi gsung rigs sngags kyi nus pa ma lus pa 'jug cing brtan par gyur cig ces me tog 'thor/ de nas mchod pa byin rlabs sngon tu 'gro ba'i mdun bskyed gsal 'debs pa la spyan dmigs 'di ltar mdzad 'tshal/ zhes brda sbyar nas/ mchod pa kha gsos te/ gong gsal mchod pa byin rlabs nas/ bstod pa'i bar slob dpon gyis brjod la brda sprad/ mdun bskyed kyi gtso bor yab yum gyi thugs kar zla ba'i steng du rang rang gi sa bon gyi mthar sngags phreng gis bskor ba las sngags phreng gnyis pa byung*/ zhal nas thon/ khyed rang rnams kyi zhal du zhugs/ thugs ka'i sa bon la thim pa'i mos pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ gtso bo yab yum gyi sngags lan gsum/ 'khor gyi lha rnams kyi rang rang gi thugs ka'i zla steng sa bon las rang rang gi sngags rnams byung*/ zhal nas zhal du brgyud/ khyed rang rnams kyi thugs srog la thim pa'i mos pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ 'khor sngags rnams lan gsum gsum bzlar gzhug mthar me tog 'thor bzhin du/ bcom ldan 'di la stsal lags kyi// bcom ldan 'di la byin gyis rlobs// lan gsum/ de nas mdun bskyed la chu sbyin dang gtor ma 'bul ba'ang nged kyis brda sprad pa'i dmigs rim la 'jug par zhu/ zhes chu sbyin dang gtor 'bul dpon slob lhan cig pas phul/ des rig gtad grub nas 'di dag lhag pa'i lhar 'dzin snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ gtso bos ji ltar sogs/ gtang rag maṇ+ḍal/ dge bsngo byas pas grub bo// rjes mchod pa kha gso/

byin rlabs mchod bstod gong gsal/ ma 'byor pa dang sogs/ yig brgya brjod/ rten yod na mdun bskyed rnams de la bstim zhing med na/ oṃ khyed kyis sems can sogs kyis gshegs su gsol/ bdag bskyed 'od gsal du bsdu zhing skad cig gis thun mtshams kyi lhar ldangs la gnas gsum 'bru gsum gyis bsrung*/ dge ba bsngo'o// ༈ /oṃ swa sti/ gang zhig bsnyen pas 'dod rgu'i dpal// yid bzhin sbyin mdzad bla ma lhar// btud nas phun tshogs gter chen po'i// bum bzang sgrub pa'i man ngag 'bri// 'di la gsum/ sbyor ba/ dngos gzhi/ rjes so// dang po ni/ sgrub pa po rdor phreng nang gi nor rgyun ma'i dkyil 'khor du dbang thob pa'am/ ma thob kyang rigs gsum spyi'am/ a ra pa tsa na lha lnga'i dkyil 'khor du dbang thob pa/ 'di nyid kyi 'khor lo la brten pa'i rjes gnang ngam/ sgrub thabs rgya mtsho nas 'byung ba'i rjes gnang legs par thob cing*/ dam tshig dang sdom pa rnam par dag pas sngon du bsnyen pa rgyas bsdus gang rigs dang*/ 'khor lo sgrub pa sogs ji skad bshad pa bzhin tshags su chud par byas nas lag len dngos ni/ rin po che'am rdza'i bum pa gas chag med pa'i nang du ke tshe dang bra bo ma gtogs pa'i 'bru sna tshogs/ ra gan zha nye 'khar ba ma gtogs pa'i rin po che sna tshogs/ dug rigs dang gla rtsi ma gtogs pa'i sman sna tshogs/ sha chang sgog rigs ma gtogs pa'i zas sna tshogs/ dar sna/ gos sna/ snam ras rnams rgyal khab phyug po'i lag nas byung ba rab/ min kyang bkra shis pa'i gang zag las rnyed pa dang*/ gzhan yang gnas dang gang zag byin rlabs can dang*/ bsod nams can dang dpal g.yang can gyi khangs zhing sa rta phyugs kyi spu sogs dge ba'i rdzas ci 'byor pa blugs/ khyad par rje btsun rin po ches 'khor lo'i man ngag las/ za ma tog chen po'i nang du bzhag la/ mar dang sbrang rtsi dang sha kha ras nub par byas te/

dus rgyun du me tog la sogs pas mchod pa byas nas dngos grub thams cad grub par 'gyur ro// zhes gsungs pa ltar zhun mar dang sbrang rtsi ka ra rnams kyis gtams/ bum pa'i stod kyi char 'khor lo rab gnas can steng 'og dang mdun rgyab ma nor bar na bza' ser po dang bcas te gzhug slar yang 'bru sna dang sman sna bsres pas 'thas par dgang*/ spro na skabs rnams su bkra shis rtags brgyad/ rdzas brgyad/ rin chen sna bdun/ 'dod yon nyer spyod bcas bris pa'am 'jim pa la par btab pa yang gzhug kha spra tshil lam 'jim pa gtsang mas srub med par bkag mgrin pa yan chad ras gtsang mas dkris la mdun du bkra shis rtags brgyad dam nor bu bri/ de lta bu'i bum pa du yod gzhi gtsang mar pad+ma 'dab brgyad re bris pa'i steng du bzhag mthar mchod pa dang gtor ma bsham/ gzungs thag ser po gdags/ gnyis pa ni/ skyabs 'gro nas bzung bdag bskyed bzlas pa dang dkyil 'khor bsdu ba'i bar sngon du 'gro bas/ bum pa bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las bum pa'i grangs dang mnyam pa'i pam̐ las pad+ma dang a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du bh+rūm̐ las rin po che'i bum pa yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du rin po che dang*/ 'bru bcud dang*/ zas nor longs spyod lha mi'i dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs pas yongs su gang bar gyur/ ces dang*/ rgyas par spro na tshig lhug rnams mi dgos par sngags drug phyag drug tsam spyi ltar dang*/ mi nus na nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgya dang bcas/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yo sogs nas/ i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ swā hā zhes lan gsum gyis/ yo byad thams cad 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga'i rang bzhin dgos 'dod thams cad 'byung ba zad mi shes pa'i gter du gyur par bsam/ de lta bu'i bum pa'i stod kyi char pam̐ las pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte ba dang 'dab ma rnams la zla ba'i dkyil 'khor re re/ dbus gyi gdan gyi steng du bam̐ dang 'bras kyi snye ma las nor rgyun mar gsal ba'i brla g.yon pa'i steng du/

dzam̐ dang bī dza pū ra ka las dzam+bha la dang 'khor rnams skad cig gis shar du zla 'od ma dang nor bu bzang po/ lhor sbyin ma dang gang ba bzang po/ nub tu rab sbyin ma dang nor sbyin/ byang du 'phags ma dang rnam thos sras/ shar lhor rab tu bzang mo dang rol pa'i phreng ba/ lho nub tu sbas ma dang 'jam po 'khyil ba/ nub byang du mdzes ma dang gdong gi dbang po/ byang shar du dbyangs can ma dang spyod pa'i dbang po/ thams cad kyang sku mdog ser po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ dar gyi na bza' can/ mo rnams kyi phyag g.yas pas shing thog bī dza pū ra ka dang bcas pa'i mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya can/ g.yon pa rnams kyis 'bras kyi snye ma thugs kar 'dzin pa/ bud med sgyu ma'i nga rgyal gyis 'gyings pa/ rin po che 'bar ba skyugs par gyur pa'i pad+ma'i gter la sogs pa'i steng du skyil krung phyed pas bzhugs pa'i brla g.yon pa rnams kyi steng du/ pho rnams rol pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa'i phyag g.yas pa rnams shing tog bī dza pū ra ka 'dzin pas mo rnams kyi g.yon nas 'gul par 'khyud pa/ g.yon pa rnams kyis ne'u le 'dzin pa'o// lha thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ rang gi snying ga'i bam̐ yig las 'od zer 'phros pas/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas dpal mo nor rgyun ma la nor lha'i tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes pas spyan drangs pa la/ oṃ shrī ba su dha ri ṇī maṇ+ḍa la sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ badz+ra pā d+yaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pai āḥhūm̐ nas/ shab+da āḥhūm̐ gi bar sbyar bas mchod/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥs mdun bskyed la gnyis su med par thim/ slar yang rang gi snying ga'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes pas spyan drangs la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pañtsa ku la sa pa ri wā ra sbyar ba'i ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/

de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 'di rnams la mngon par dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs nas/ shrī ye hūm̐ zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang*/ dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las thams cad la rin chen 'byung ldan gyis dbur brgyan/ mchod pa bsang sbyang byin gyis brlabs nas/ thal mo sbyar te/ 'jig rten khams 'di'am dpag med na// mchod yon ji snyed yod pa rnams// 'phags ma 'khor dang bcas la dbul// bzhes nas dpal 'byor rgyas par mdzod// oṃ shrī ba su dha ri ṇī maṇ+ḍa la sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ya āḥhūm̐/ zhes dang*/ de bzhin du/ zhabs bsil dang*/ me tog sogs nas/ rol mo'i bar 'don pa bsgyur la dbul zhing*/ dharma ra ṇi ta sogs brjod/ spro na/ rtsibs stong ldan pa'i gser gyi 'khor lo sogs// rgya chen bsod nams dpal las legs grub pa// mi yi dbang po'i rin chen sna bdun 'bul// bzhes nas dpal 'byor rgyas pa'i dngos grub stsol// oṃ shrī ba su dā ri ṇī maṇ+ḍa la sa pa ri wā ra sap+ta rat+na pū dzi te hūm̐/ g.yul las rgyal bar byed pa'i ral gri sogs// bsod nams du ma'i mthu yis legs bskyed pa'i// sa bdag nye ba'i rin chen sna bdun 'bul// bzhes nas dpal 'byor rgyas pa'i dngos grub stsol// oṃ shrī ba su dha ri ṇī maṇ+ḍa la sa pa ri wā ra sap+ta u pa rat+na pū dzi te hūm̐/ yid 'ong gzugs dang rnar snyan sgra la sogs// bsod nams du ma'i mthu yis legs bskyed pa'i// mtho ris 'gro ba'i 'dod yon rnam lnga 'bul// bzhes nas dpal 'byor rgyas pa'i dngos grub stsol// oṃ shrī ba su dha ri ṇī maṇ+ḍa la sa pa ri wā ra pañtsa kā ma gu ṇa pū dzi te hūm̐/ thub pas byin brlabs me long sogs dang ni// sku yi cha shas dbyibs mtshon dpal be'u sogs// bkra shis sgrub pa'i rdzas dang rtags brgyad 'bul// bzhes nas dpal 'byor rgyas pa'i dngos grub stsol// oṃ shrī ba su dha ri ṇī maṇ+ḍa la sa pa ri wā ra maṅga la aṣ+ṭa dra bya tsih+ṇa pū dzi te hūm̐ zhes pa'i sngags rnams la nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgya bya zhing mchod/

rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ phun tshogs dge legs kun 'byung bcom ldan ma// dpal dang 'byor pa'i dbang phyug nor rgyun ma// yid la re ba'i bkra shis stsol mdzad ma// bsam 'phel dkyil 'khor dbang phyug ma la 'dud// gang sngon sbyin pa rgya mtsho'i dge bsags pas// tshe dang nor dang mthu yi dpal brnyes nas// sgrub pa po la dbyig gi char 'bebs pa'i// nor sbyin yab yum 'khor dang bcas la bstod// ces bstod/ gtor ma chu gtsang mas sbyang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum gyis brlab/ sngags rnams kyi mthar/ i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi sarba sid+dhim+me pra yats+tshan+tu hūm̐ phaṭa ces lan gsum sogs kyis phul/ oṃ shrī ba su dha ri ṇī maṇ+ḍa la sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ sogs nas/ shab+da'i bar sbyar bas mchod/ phun tshogs dge legs kun 'byung sogs kyis bstod/ bcom ldan 'das ma 'khor dang bcas pas bdag dang sbyin pa'i bdag pos gtsor byas sems can thams cad la 'dod rgu'i 'byor pa'i dngos grub zad mi shes pa stsal du gsol zhes 'dod don gsol/ gzungs thag nas bzung ste/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer sngags phreng gi rnam pa can 'phros pas lha rnams kyi thugs rgyud bskul/ de rnams kyi sku las 'od zer pho nya lta bu bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'phros/ 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad khyab/ sangs rgyas byang sems nyan rang*/ 'phags pa'i tshogs kyi byin rlabs nus mthu thams cad 'od zer ser po'i rnam par spyan drangs shing*/ de dang dus mnyam du srid pa gsum gyi dpal 'byor longs spyod bcud g.yang dang bcas pa thams cad bkrag mdangs gzi brjid can gyi rnam par bkug ste/ bum pa'i nang gi rdzas rnams la gnyis su med par thim pas 'dod rgu'i dpal 'byor zad mi shes pa'i gter gyi bum pa bzang por gyur/ bum pa'i nang gi dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs pa rab tu 'phel zhing kha nas lhud kyis lud/

lha rnams kyi sku dang phyag mtshan rnams las kyang rin po che dang 'bras sogs mkho dgu longs spyod kyi char chen po chil chil babs pas gnas khang dang*/ gtsug lag khang dang*/ bang mdzod la sogs pa mer gyis khengs pas bdag dang sbyin bdag gis mtshon pa'i sems can thams cad bsam pa rdzogs par gyur ces brjod cing bsams la/ oṃ ba su dha ri ṇ+yai swā hā zhes gtso bor bzla/ thun mtshams su 'khor rnams la/ oṃ tsan+t+ra kān+t+yai swā hā/ de bzhin du/ dat+tā yai/ su dat+tā yai/ ār+ya yai/ su bha drā yai/ gup+ta yai/ de byai/ sa ra swa t+yai swā hā zhes pas yum rnams dang*/ oṃ dzam+bha la dza len+d+ra ya swā hā/ de bzhin du/ ma ṇi bha drā ya/ pūr+ṇa bha drā ya/ dha na dā ya/ bai shra ba ṇā ya/ ke li mā li ni/ pi tsi kuṇ+ḍa li ni/ mu khen+d+rā ya/ oṃ tsa ren+d+rā ya swā hā/ zhes pa yab rnams te so sor gtso mo'i bcu cha re bzla/ thun bsdu ba na/ mchod pa bsang sbyang byin gyis brlabs la/ oṃ shrī ba su dha ri ṇī sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha nas/ shab+da'i bar sbyar bas mchod/ phun tshogs dge legs sogs kyis bstod/ yig brgya lan gsum/ ma 'byor pa dang sogs kyis bzod par gsol/ de nas me tog ser po thogs la/ bcom ldan 'das ma 'phags ma nor rgyun ma'i lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa khyed rnams rten 'di rnams la brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ brtan par bzhugs nas rten 'di rnams gang du bzhugs pa'i yul phyogs dang gnas khang thams cad du lo phyugs legs shing*/ 'bru bcud dar ba dang*/ srid zhi'i dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs pa thams cad rgya mtsho chen po la chu bo'i rgyun bzhin du 'du bar mdzad du gsol zhes dang*/ su pra tiṣ+ṭha dang*/ ye dharmā mang du brjod cing me tog 'thor ro// de lta bu'i gsol gdab brtan bzhugs lan gsum mam bdun la sogs pa gang mang bya/ rang gi dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/

thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po zhes gnas gsum bsrung*/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /nor rgyun dpal mo 'grub gyur nas// sogs dang*/ thams cad nam mkha'i mdzod bzhin du// longs spyod zad pa med par shog /rtsod pa med cing 'tshe med pa// rang dbang du ni spyod par shog /lha yang dus su char 'bebs shing*// lo tog phun sum tshogs par shog /rgyal po chos bzhin byed pa dang*// 'jig rten dag kyang dar bar shog /'bad dang rtsol bas ma gos pa// yid bzhin nor bu dpag bsam bzhin// sems can re ba skong mdzad pa// bsam pa 'grub pa'i bkra shis shog /ces sogs bsngo smon shis brjod khyad par ba dang*/ gzhan yang*/ che ba'i che mchog sogs mdo rgyud nas 'byung ba'i bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa rgya cher brjod/ de lta bu'i thun du bcad nas rang ngam sbyin bdag la rmi ltas dge ba lta bu'i rtags ma byung ba'i bar ram zhag bdun sogs bsgrub bo// gsum pa ni/ de ltar legs par bsgrubs pa'i mthar bang mdzod kyi phug phyugs lhas kyi gong*/ zhing sa bzang po'i dkyil sogs gang du 'jog pa'i sar spyan drangs te sgrom bu'i nang du pad+ma 'dab brgyad bris pa'i steng du zhal phyi sgo dang*/ lung pa'i mda' sogs dang mi 'phrod par byas te mchod pa'i bye brag dang bcas te bzhag brtan bzhugs dang shis brjod rgyas par bya/ dus dang dus su me tog sogs nyer spyod dang*/ zas sna'i phud sogs kyis mchod na 'dod rgu'i dngos grub nges par ster bar 'gyur la/ gal te sngar bsgrubs nas yun ring song ba yin na bzhag dus zhal gso ba'i don du sngar bshad pa ltar gyi cho ga tshar gcig bskyar na'ang legs par 'gyur ro// tshul 'di rje e wam̐ pa dkon mchog dpal ldan sogs kyis gsang 'dus kyi phyogs su gtogs par mdzad pa'ang*/ cho ga'i yan lag rnams bla med ltar bkral ba'i dbang du byas na 'gal ba med mod/ 'on kyang gzhi'i rgyud 'jam dpal dpa' bo grub pa ni rgyud sde 'og ma yin pas/

cho ga spyi khyab tsam la'ang brten du rung bas/ de ltar na mchod pa bsang sngags sogs a mṛ tes bya ba dang*/ rol mo byin gyi rlob pa'i sngags dharmā ra ṇi brjod pa tsam khyad par ro// gang ltar yang khrus dang gtsang sbra sogs kun spyod ni rgyud sde 'og ma ltar bya ba gal che'o// gnod sbyin 'khor lo la brten nas// 'dod rgu'i mchog stsol gter chen po'i// bum bzang sgrub thabs bgyis pa'i dges// srid zhi'i dge mtshan rgyas gyur cig /ces pa'ang 'jam mgon bla ma ngag gi dbang pos mdzad pa'i yig cha lung rgyun ma bzhugs pa'i stabs kyis/ gsung rab de nyid kyi dgongs don ltar bya bral ba mañdzu gho ṣas bklags chog tu dag par bris pa dge legs mchog tu gyur cig de ltar rjes gnang gi yi ge gsar spel bcas blo gter dbang pos dkyus gcig tu bsgrigs pa dge/ // ༈ bal yul mchod rten rin po che bya rung kha shor gyi nye 'gram rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa glog klad dpar khang las/ bder gshegs 7skyabs rje bco brgyad khri chen rdo rje 'chang mchog gi thugs dgongs rdzogs ched/ skyabs 'og pa tshar grwa gu rus glog klad phyag deb ched 'grem spel zhus pa'i dge 'bras sangs rgyas zhing du bsngo'o// //
